digest.component_or_area: rebar metrics surface and project documentation
propositions: rebar-janitor's Discovery phase needs to consult `rebar metrics --since/--until --output json` output as durable historical evidence for code-health trends, complementing one-shot tools like cloc/tokei/ast-grep

Project documentation must surface the `rebar metrics` command and its four metric lenses (agent_process, code_health, delivery, gate_economics) so contributors and agents can discover and use the metrics
The metrics surface must document the `unavailable{reason,accruing_since}` state and `source`/`confidence` labels so agents do not misinterpret absent metrics as zero values
The reusable `rebar.metrics` registry subsystem (MetricSpec, REGISTRY, is_authoritative segregation) must be referenced in docs/reuse-surface.md so library consumers can discover it

Discovery.md must include a caveat that registered code-health-lens metrics (module-size distribution, oversized-module count, module-size trend vs 800-cap, churn, refactor-to-addition ratio, cap-change events) are historical/trend complements to snapshots, not replacements
